assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: landscape editorial illustration for a card on an Indonesian boys' Islamic boarding school website (An-Nahl).
Style: sophisticated warm digital gouache illustration with subtle paper grain, softly modeled shapes, clean organic silhouettes, carefully drawn natural hands and faces. A polished educational brand illustration, calm and welcoming, not a childish cartoon, not a photograph, no photorealistic claims.
Composition: horizontal landscape 3:2, scene readable at small card sizes, subject and main activity in the middle two thirds, generous safe margins. Fill the entire canvas with the scene; no white frame.
Palette: deep forest green, muted sage, warm ivory, a few restrained honey-gold accents. Gentle daylight, lush West Java greenery and modest Indonesian pesantren architecture in the background.
All students are male Indonesian Muslim santri, appropriately modest clothing and black or white peci caps. No female figures. No logos, no watermark, no writing, no letters, no Arabic calligraphy, no UI, no cards, no borders. Open books have subtle abstract marks only.
Scene: elementary education. Two boys aged 8–10 in clean white shirts and dark green trousers, sitting at a low wooden table in a bright open-sided learning pavilion, enjoying a colorful open schoolbook together. One boy gently points at the page; the other smiles attentively. A pencil and a small stack of books support the learning theme. Friendly and curious, serene school garden beyond.
